description: This file declares interfaces related to log uploading functionalities within the WPEFramework Plugin namespace. It includes an enum for error types and function prototypes for parameter retrieval, pre-sleep log upload, and asynchronous log upload.

methods.name: getUploadLogParameters
methods.description: Retrieves parameters related to log uploading.

methods.name: LogUploadBeforeDeepSleep
methods.description: Initiates log upload before device enters deep sleep mode.

methods.name: logUploadAsync
methods.description: Performs asynchronous log upload and returns a process ID.
